लॉस एंजिल्स में हाल ही में बहुप्रतीक्षित फिल्म Ramayana: Part 1 का वर्ल्ड प्रीमियर हुआ है जिसके बाद सोशल मीडिया प्लेटफॉर्म X पर अर्ली रिएक्शंस सामने आ गए हैं। 🎬

इस एपिक फिल्म को Nitesh Tiwari ने डायरेक्ट किया है और Namit Malhotra तथा Yash इसके प्रोड्यूसर हैं। 🎥

फिल्म में Ranbir Kapoor, Yash और Sai Pallavi लीड रोल में नजर आ रहे हैं, साथ ही Ravi Dubey, Sunny Deol, Kajal Aggarwal, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor, Arun Govil और Lara Dutta जैसे कलाकार भी शामिल हैं। 🌟

क्रिटिक्स और सोशल मीडिया यूजर्स के मुताबिक फिल्म के विजुअल्स, डांस, म्यूजिक और एक्शन बहुत शानदार हैं और रणबीर तथा यश के काम की तारीफ हो रही है। 👍

हालांकि कुछ रिव्यूज़ के मुताबिक फिल्म ड्रामा और इमोशन के मुकाबले स्पेक्टकल और एक्शन पर ज्यादा ध्यान देती है जिससे नरेशन फ्लैट लग सकता है और सेकंड हाफ ड्रैग होता है। ⏳

Hans Zimmer और A. R. Rahman ने फिल्म का स्कोर तैयार किया है और यह फिल्म दुनिया भर में दिवाली की छुट्टियों यानी 5 नवंबर को रिलीज होने के लिए सेट है। 🎵

क्या आप Ramayana के इस फर्स्ट पार्ट को देखने के लिए थिएटर जा रहे हैं? नीचे कमेंट करके बताएं! 👇

ctx.text:
Ramayana is one of the biggest and most-anticipated releases of this year. It held its world premiere in LA recently, and critics and journalists cannot contain their reactions. The first reactions to this Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi starrer are all over the social media platform X [formerly Twitter]. Scroll below to find out!
The epic movie is directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash. It is not just any story but an emotion for the Indian audience. There were a few controversies around the film, but it is finally set to be released worldwide during the Diwali holidays. Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi appear in the leading roles, with an ensemble cast comprising Ravi Dubey, Sunny Deol, Kajal Aggarwal, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor, Arun Govil, and Lara Dutta.
For the uninitiated, this is the first part of the movie, titled Ramayana: Part 1. The movie premiered at the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures. The first reactions are being shared on social media X [formerly Twitter]. A user called @L0rdshen1 said “#OneWordReview #Ramayana: EPIC. Ranbir as Lord Rama is outstanding – graceful & divine. Yash as Ravana is phenomenal & magnetic. A grand spectacle with breathtaking visuals. Sure-shot BLOCKBUSTER.”
#OneWordReview #Ramayana : EPIC. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Ranbir as Lord Rama is outstanding – graceful & divine. Yash as Ravana is phenomenal & magnetic. A grand spectacle with breathtaking visuals. Sure-shot BLOCKBUSTER. pic.twitter.com/h8FtTYk7nJ
MPA-Accredited Entertainment Journalist Rama’s Screen said, “Ramayana Rise of a Legend was spectacular! The visuals, the dances, the music, the action were all colossal. Ranbir Kapoor was sublime; Yash was magnetic. One of this year’s most immersive cinematic experiences. A grand spectacle!”
Ramayana Rise of a Legend was spectacular! The visuals, the dances, the music, the action were all colossal. Ranbir Kapoor was sublime, Yash was magnetic. One of this year’s most immersive cinematic experiences. A grand spectacle! #Ramayana pic.twitter.com/MAw7rNaqS1
Kuldeep Gadhvi writes, “WOW stunning visuals absolutely grand and cinematic.”
#Ramayana WOW stunning visuals absolutely grand and cinematic
The post-credit scene of #Ramayana : Rise of a Legend is an absolute game changer It leaves you craving more and makes the wait for Part 2 even more unbearable. The excitement is unreal, and now I just can't wait for 2028! ❤️‍🔥
Venky Reviews said, “A hugely ambitious film mounted on a grand scale, and the effort behind it is clearly visible. The team largely stays true to the Ramayana, but the film leans more on spectacle and action than drama and emotion, leaving parts of the narration feeling flat and even serial like at times. The second half also drags in places because of where Part 1 chooses to end, with limited material stretched out through lengthy action blocks that don’t create much impact.” Check out the full review below.

Johanna “Jojo” Atilano @jojoatilano adds, “Honestly, damn. @WorldOfRamayana is legit a theme park ride for almost 3 hours. Beautiful music by Hans Zimmer & AR Rahman.”
Honestly, damn. @WorldOfRamayana is legit a theme park ride for almost 3 hours. Beautiful music by Hans Zimmer & AR Rahman. pic.twitter.com/IXktxlDvHh
Hans Zimmer and A. R. Rahman have joined forces to compose the film’s score, marking Zimmer’s debut in the Indian film industry. It ends with a cliffhanger as well. The story is known to all. The story follows Prince Rama’s journey from his early victories and marriage to Princess Sita to his unjust 14-year exile from Ayodhya.
